import os
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "schemes.sqlite3"

# Deliberately unparameterised when true, so the drifting fixture run can be
# recorded leaving a live SQL injection sink for the exploit-probe check.
UNSAFE_QUERY = os.getenv("FIXTURE_UNSAFE_QUERY", "true").lower() == "true"


def init_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schemes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, min_income INTEGER)"
    )
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM schemes")
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO schemes (name, min_income) VALUES (?, ?)",
        [("Rural Housing Grant", 0), ("Student Stipend", 20000), ("Senior Pension Top-up", 0)],
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def search_schemes(income: str):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    if UNSAFE_QUERY:
        cur.execute(f"SELECT name FROM schemes WHERE min_income <= {income}")  # noqa: S608
    else:
        cur.execute("SELECT name FROM schemes WHERE min_income <= ?", (income,))
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return [r[0] for r in rows]

from features.schemes import BioValidationError, find_eligible_schemes, parse_bio
from features.schemes import finder


SAMPLE_SCHEMES = [
    {"name": "Rural Housing Grant", "min_income": 0},
    {"name": "Student Stipend", "min_income": 20000},
    {"name": "Senior Pension Top-up", "min_income": 0},
]


def test_parse_bio_extracts_income_from_free_text():
    parsed = parse_bio("I am a rural worker and my annual income is ₹12,500.")

    assert parsed.income == 12500
    assert "rural worker" in parsed.text


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bio", ["", "12345", "I have no income details", "My income is -100"])
def test_parse_bio_rejects_invalid_input(bio):
    with pytest.raises(BioValidationError):
        parse_bio(bio)


def test_find_eligible_schemes_explains_income_eligibility():
    results = find_eligible_schemes(
        "Student with salary 15000 per year",
        schemes=SAMPLE_SCHEMES,
    )

    by_name = {result.name: result for result in results}
    assert by_name["Rural Housing Grant"].eligible is True
    assert "meets" in by_name["Rural Housing Grant"].reason
    assert by_name["Student Stipend"].eligible is False
    assert "does not meet" in by_name["Student Stipend"].reason


def test_find_eligible_schemes_calls_live_api_when_schemes_not_injected(monkeypatch):
    calls = []

    def fake_fetch(query):
        calls.append(query)
        return SAMPLE_SCHEMES

    monkeypatch.setattr(finder, "fetch_live_schemes", fake_fetch)

    results = finder.find_eligible_schemes("My income is 25000", query="education")

    assert calls == ["education"]
    assert any(result.name == "Student Stipend" and result.eligible for result in results)
"}
